messages:
emma: Heads-up: publisher wants a joint announcement + cloudstore listing. Need to finalize branding assets, cross-account role, and privacy notes by Friday. Who can front each?

tony: I can do the infra pieces: role, bucket, KMS. Need publisher account IDs and whether they prefer EU key.

rachel: I'll handle creative/branding. What sizes do marketplaces need? And do we have a one-sheeter for the joint announcement?

emma: Marketplace image constraints differ but keep hero 1280x720, logo PNG 512x512, and a 1-paragraph blurb. I'll share the announcement draft in the drive.

tony: For roles: plan is cross-account role with condition on ExternalId and PutObject limited to /ingest/{sku}/*. Will add lifecycle rule to remove staging assets after 45 days. CLI snippet: ```bash
aws iam create-role --role-name pub-ingest-role --assume-role-policy-document file://trust.json
aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket rw-market-staging --lifecycle-configuration file://lifecycle.json
```

legal: Quick flag: publisher requests telemetry for usage-based billing. Default stance: aggregated metrics only; any user-level telemetry needs DPA / consent. Also require a data processing addendum for EU residency.

rachel: Copy. I'll make the branding pack and include an assets-spec.md. Also will draft the announcement paragraph and share comments.

emma: Action items: tony -> infra + KMS policy (ETA: Thu). rachel -> branding + announcement copy (ETA: Wed). legal -> DPA draft + telemetry guidance (ETA: Thu). I'll set up a reviewer pass on Fri AM.

ops-bot: Onboarding checklist created: checklist#98, assigned to [tony,rachel,legal,emma].
	emma: Thanks — please drop publisher IDs here when available so tony can create the role. 

tony: Will do. :thumbsup:
